description: SQL-PIVOT-04, deciding variant: headings that render alike from different typed values. PvT's Piv is Text ('1', '1.0', '01', ' 1', 'a', 'A') and PvN's Piv is Double (1, 1.5, 10, 1.5, 1, -1); asks the dynamic crosstab over each, and fixed IN lists ('1','1.0','01') and (1, 1.5, 10), with the schema (Name, Type, Size) read before the first move and the rows. Follow-up probe (status F) for SQL-PIVOT-04, SQL-PIVOT-01; runs on a read-only open of fixture r-q-expr-sql-main through DAO.DBEngine.120; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field. Each statement is preceded by a marker (a DROP TABLE of a table that does not exist, which always fails), so DBEngine.Errors read after the statement shows that statement's own failure or the marker's, never an older one.
retentionNote: Designed r-q-expr-sql probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
